subject: mathematics
concept: Classifying quadrilaterals and their properties (square, rectangle, parallelogram, rhombus, trapezoid)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student manipulates a virtual flexible quadrilateral frame to explore which properties stay fixed
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts pictured quadrilaterals by their side and angle properties
exercise.abstract: Student names a quadrilateral from a written list of its properties

misconception_flags: confuses rhombus and square, or parallelogram and trapezoid

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
